notes.key_messages:
Candidates should possess a thorough knowledge and understanding of all topics in the syllabus. This is
especially the case when applying economic analysis to numerical, diagrammatic and graphical data.
To have a clear understanding of what is required, it is important for candidates to read through each item
very carefully before selecting an option on the answer sheet.
